text:
chris.marketplace: Quick check  we need to finalize proctoring & cert delivery for SI beta cohort. Marketplace listing asks for "certified" badge by launch. Can we support same-week proctoring?

rahul.si_programs: Ideally yes, but proctor capacity is the limiter. We have 2 proctors on rotation. Max 12 candidates/week with 30m slots. Can we prioritize partner leads? :calendar:

marco.training: We could compress the knowledge check into a 20-min practical + 10-min oral. Keeps throughput higher. Proctor checklist will include environment verification and identity match.

zoe.ops: Environment verification note: partner lab VMs must have outbound logging enabled for audit (we already do this for private pilots). We'll require a pre-check script. I'll add it to the repo.

ci-bot: ci:si-cert-runbook.md updated -> pipeline passed :white_check_mark: (2 changed files)

chris.marketplace: Sophie/legal  are we fine with partner names + logos on the marketplace announcement if they complete certs during beta? Need sign-off.

sophie.legal: Quick rules: partners must sign the co-marketing MSA addendum. Also no use of Redwood trademarks beyond marketplace badge design. I'll post an addendum template now.

rahul.si_programs: On scheduling  propose weekly proctor slots Tue/Thu 14:00-17:00 PT, bookable via Calendly. Partners pick slots after they finish the rubric labs. Can Marco & Zoe confirm proctoring runbook and pre-check link?

marco.training: Will publish runbook and oral question bank. Note: oral questions are meant to validate troubleshooting and config choices, not memorize docs. Template: 5 scenario prompts + expected checks.

zoe.ops: Pre-check script uploaded: https://internal.redwood/si/precheck.sh (internal). It verifies network egress, GPU availability, and token validity. We gate booking behind a successful precheck.

elaine.gtm: Marketing timeline: if partners can certify by 10/28, we can include first three partners in the marketplace hero carousel for 11/02. Need logos + approved quotes by 10/25.

chris.marketplace: Actionable items: Sophie to share addendum; Marco to publish runbook; Zoe to finalize pre-check; Rahul to open Calendly with times; Elaine to prepare creative checklist for partners.

rahul.si_programs: I'll create the Calendly and share link here by EOD today. Also we should decide on recert cadence (6 mo vs 12 mo). Thoughts?

sophie.legal: Recommend 12 months for now. Shorter cadence creates operational load and more contract churn. We can revisit after cohort 1.

marco.training: Agree 12 months. Also recommend a one-off "retraining" if partner fails >2 attempts.

chris.marketplace: OK. I'll draft the partner notification template with marketplace badge rules. Also we need to record a 10-min "what passing looks like" video for partners. Marco can record.

ci-bot: calendar:proctor-rotation updated -> new events added for Oct/Nov

marco.training: I'll record the video tomorrow and drop it in the docs site. Any objections to sample content? 1) quick lab walkthrough 2) common pitfalls 3) how to contact support during proctoring.

elaine.gtm: Sounds good. One more ask: partners need a one-click logo upload flow and simple legal checkbox. UX team can quick-wire this if we have copy.

zoe.ops: Note: enforce single-use voucher code redemption before certification booking. Otherwise hardware voucher could be claimed prematurely.

chris.marketplace: Great catch. Let's add that to the runbook. Tough timeline but doable if we all commit. I'll follow up with a short checklist and timeline in this thread.
